info.title: Optional Patient Insurance Information
info.description: M1-B: insurance never blocks registration, patient updates, booking, check-in or treatment. Provider-only associations are separate from optional encrypted policy revisions and manual external check observations. No insurer/card-reader API, benefit calculation, responsibility allocation, claims, settlement, evidence activation or external disclosure. Uses exact patient_insurance.view/manage/reveal capabilities plus patient access, existing Sanctum and tenant context. Ordinary identifiers are masked; cleartext requires a separate audited reveal. Free-text provider names remain unverified and never create catalog entries.
